gen-gf-krub-fs-erode: Open apertures and a tiny cap gap mark Krub. Erode still holds if the copy drops a size, a mild wire-flat taper under those open letters.
gen-gf-kufam-fs-erode: Daylight in every curve: Kufam draws a tube-like rod against Erode. And Erode prefers a slightly reduced size, with a light tug of heavier verticals below.
gen-gf-kufam-fs-karma: Karma reads classic under Kufam's equal-width cut strips. A slightly reduced size still holds, with just enough weight shift to notice beside that constant tube stroke.

gen-gf-lexend-deca-fs-erode: Clean Lexend Deca matches diagonal heft to verticals, a high-waisted lowercase with terminals cut short of the bowl. Erode stays dignified through dense copy with a lettering-pen thick-thin.
gen-gf-lexend-exa-fs-erode: Inflated lowercase bowls and generous glyph gaps mark Lexend Exa, a rounded nib with no hairline thinning. Erode lets paragraphs keep moving with moderate thicks and thins.
gen-gf-lexend-giga-fs-karma: Wide-set letters and a soaring x-height mark Lexend Giga. Karma stays trustworthy through dense copy, with a mild stress in the rounds and terminals that stop short of each stem.
gen-gf-lexend-tera-fs-karma: A steady, classic read is Karma under Lexend Tera's rope strokes and wide gaps. Karma then holds paragraphs with only a light shift of weight throughout.
gen-gf-lexend-zetta-fs-erode: Editorial, dignified Erode sits under Lexend Zetta's constant ribbon and wide-spaced letters. Erode still holds if the copy drops a size, with slimmer crossbars than stems.
gen-gf-lexend-zetta-fs-karma: A constant-width ribbon and a generous cushion of space mark Lexend Zetta. Karma keeps copy moving with a mild shimmer of weight that never snags the eye.
